summary:
KnowYou 1.2.4 makes the app feel cleaner and makes future updates easier.

- Cleaner app window: the KnowYou title, app icon, privacy reminder, and Diary Engine control now stay aligned in the title bar.
- Better app icon: the Dock icon is slightly larger and better centered.
- Smoother Diary Engine startup: KnowYou now remembers when your selected Diary Engine was already working, so it should not briefly flash a warning every time you open the app.
- Easier future updates: after installing this version, future direct-download updates can be completed inside KnowYou instead of downloading a new DMG and dragging the app again.
- Clearer update notes: update messages now explain what changed in plain language.
